inputs.vintage: fhfa_hpi_county: Annual developmental index, latest release
limits: 100% of 65 prices county rows filled

Repeat-sales index built from mortgages bought or guaranteed by Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac; thin in rural counties, where years can be missing. Published as a spreadsheet (read with the standard library's zip and XML tools).

inputs.label: Average offered mortgage rates by year
inputs.vintage: freddie_pmms: Weekly, 1971 to the latest week
limits: 100% of 56 mortgage rates year rows filled
National only; the model's rate is the ledger entry, this table is its evidence.
National average offered rates for prime borrowers, not the rate a given household or builder pays. The value used in the model is a ledger parameter with a range.

inputs.label: Construction wage index per county (local building-cost proxy)
limits: 100% of 67 costs county rows filled
Not yet applied to the ledger's hard costs, which are statewide.

Average pay of construction jobs at private employers, by where the employer reports, not where it builds. A wage index is a proxy for local building costs; materials, land and fees are not in it. BLS withholds county figures that would reveal one employer; those counties take the state value.
